Website information

Accessibility Statement

Last reviewed September 23, 2026

Our commitment

Integrative Pain Clinic is committed to providing people with disabilities meaningful access to its website and information. The clinic aims to apply widely recognized Level AA accessibility principles from the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) as the site is maintained.

Accessibility measures

The site includes measures intended to support access, including:

  • Semantic headings, landmarks, lists, links, buttons, and form-related labels.
  • Text alternatives for meaningful website images.
  • Keyboard-operable navigation, cookie controls, and visible focus indicators.
  • Responsive layouts that adapt to smaller screens and text enlargement.
  • Descriptive video titles and direct links that can be used without loading an embedded player.
  • Plain-language notices for emergency, insurance, and external-service information.

Known limitations

Some linked forms, meeting tools, maps, payment pages, videos, PDFs, and publications are operated by third parties. Their accessibility can vary, and the clinic may not be able to change those services directly. Video captions and transcripts are controlled by the video publisher unless the clinic provides a separate alternative.

Request help or an alternative format

If you cannot access website content or a linked patient resource, call (610) 732-4251. The clinic will work with you to provide the information or service through a reasonable alternative.

When reporting a problem, please share the page address, a short description of the issue, the browser or assistive technology used if known, and a preferred way for the clinic to respond. Do not include sensitive health information unless clinic staff asks for it through an appropriate channel.

Ongoing review

Accessibility is considered as website content and features are updated. Feedback helps the clinic identify barriers and prioritize corrections.
